subject: social_studies
concept: Applying social norms, peer influence, class/inequality, social change, institutions, and observation skills to a real-world reflective scenario, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student conducts a simple social observation of their own community and connects it to a unit concept
exercise.abstract: Student writes a short reflection connecting a real observation to a concept from this unit

assessment.mastery_threshold: reflection genuinely connects a real observation to a specific concept from this unit
misconception_flags: reflection restates unit concepts without connecting them to any actual observation

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
